claims.climate: Ebonyi State has a humid tropical climate with one rainy season and one dry season lasting 8 and 4 months; harmattan winds are common between December and January.
claims.craft: Locally hand-made baskets of various sizes are a minor industry at Ntezi.
claims.industry: Ebonyi's economy is based around agriculture, mainly yams, rice, oil palm and cassava, with lead, zinc and limestone mining a key minor industry around Abakaliki.
